review_candidates.description: Cyber Zscaler Network Security Engineer / Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation Deloitte's Cyber business is passionate about making an impact with lasting change. Delivering our industry leading services requires fresh thinking and a creative approach. We collaborate with teams from across our organization in order to bring the full breadth of Deloitte, its commercial and public sector expertise, to best support our clients. Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success. As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation, you will help clients modernize network security through cloud-delivered zero trust architectures. This role supports the design, deployment, and optimization of Zscaler capabilities across complex enterprise environments, helping organizations strengthen security posture, improve user access experiences, and enable secure transformation across on-premises and cloud ecosystems. Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026. Work you'll do As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the Cyber Enterprise Security team, you will be responsible for... Designing, deploying, and managing Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) capabilities across enterprise client environments Supporting zero trust network access (ZTNA) transformations, including replacement of legacy virtual private network (VPN) infrastructure and modernization of access controls Configuring and optimizing Zscaler security features, including policy administration, SSL/TLS inspection, advanced threat protection, data loss prevention, and cloud-based traffic inspection Implementing branch, cloud, and application connector architectures across on-premises and cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Developing technical deliverables, solution designs, and client-facing recommendations aligned to enterprise security, network transformation, and operational requirements A successful candidate would possess these skills: Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to provide clear guidance to others The team Our Enterprise Security offering embeds security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client's technical backbone while enabling secure digital transformation. Includes security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products. Qualifications Required Qualifications BA/BS degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience) Zscaler Digital Transformation Engineer (ZDTE) certification required 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in network security engineering 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), including web filtering, DNS security, cloud firewall, bandwidth controls, and advanced threat protection policies in enterprise-scale environments 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), including application segment configuration, access policies, connector deployment, and zero trust network access (ZTNA) architectures replacing legacy VPN infrastructure 1+ years of experience designing, deploying, and managing Zscaler Branch Connector, and configuring BGP/static routing configurations and network segmentation, replacing traditional SD-WAN platforms (e.g., Cisco, VMware, Aruba) 1+ years of experience designing, deploying, and managing Zscaler Cloud Connector, including deployment within cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), workload-to-internet and workload-to-workload traffic inspection, and integration with cloud-native networking constructs (e.g., VPCs, VNets, Transit Gateways) 3+ years of experience configuring and tuning Zscaler advanced security features, including Cloud Sandboxing, Advanced Threat Protection (ATP), Intrusion Prevention (IPS), Cloud Browser Isolation (CBI), and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies 3+ years of experience implementing and troubleshooting SSL/TLS inspection within ZIA, including certificate management, decryption policy design, bypass rules, and handling of certificate-pinned applications 1+ years of experience with Zscaler AI-powered capabilities, including AI-driven policy recommendations, Digital Experience Monitoring (ZDX), and leveraging Zscaler's AI/ML-based threat intelligence for automated threat response 3+ years of hands-on experience defining, managing, and reviewing Zscaler security policies, including rule base optimization, policy lifecycle management, access reviews, and role-based access controls within the Zscaler Admin Portal Experience implementing ZIdentity for centralize identity management. 3+ years of experience with one or more major cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) to deploy ZPA App Connectors within cloud-native architectures. 3+ years of experience deploying Zscaler Cloud Connector. Experience integrating Zscaler with SIEM/SOAR platforms (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Palo Alto XSOAR) via log streaming, API connectors, or syslog for threat detection and incident response workflows Experience with Zscaler APIs and automation tooling (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Python) for provisioning, policy management, and configuration-as-code workflows Experience designing and presenting Zscaler solution architectures tailored to client requirements, translating technical concepts for executive and non-technical stakeholders Familiarity with identity provider integrations (e.g., Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity) for SAML/SCIM-based authentication within ZIA and ZPA deployments Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you perform and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Limited immigration sponsorship may be available Preferred Qualifications Advanced cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CCIE Security, CCNP Security, or GIAC equivalents (e.g., GPEN, GCSA) Ability to conduct SASE vendor competitive analysis and advise clients on solution selection based on specific use cases and requirements (e.g., Zscaler vs. Palo Alto Prisma vs. Netskope) Ability to conduct Zero Trust Architecture assessments and develop roadmaps aligning Zscaler capabilities to NIST SP 800-207 or CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model frameworks Previous consulting or "Big 4" experience, with a track record of delivering enterprise network security or SASE transformation engagements The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. review_candidates.title: Network/Systems Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: About This Role At Biogen, our manufacturing operations rely on robust, secure, and highly available technology infrastructure to support the delivery of life-changing therapies. We are seeking a Network/Systems Support Engineer to join our Manufacturing IT team in Athlone. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting and continuously improving our Manufacturing Control Network (MCN) environment, ensuring reliable operation of critical infrastructure that supports manufacturing, laboratory, warehouse, and shop-floor systems. You will work closely with Manufacturing, Automation, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Quality, and external vendors to maintain a secure, compliant, and highly available environment operating 24/7. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced infrastructure professional who enjoys troubleshooting complex systems, driving continuous improvement, and working within a regulated manufacturing environment. Given the site's 24x7 operations, you may be required to provide on-site, off-hours, or on-call support, ensuring that our manufacturing processes run smoothly and efficiently. This role requires working on site for 5 days per week in Athlone. What You'll Do Infrastructure Operations & Support Support the day-to-day operation and maintenance of manufacturing network and systems infrastructure. Manage and troubleshoot Windows and Linux servers, virtualization platforms, network services, monitoring solutions, and backup systems. Act as a key escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents and lead root cause investigations through resolution. Ensure reliable connectivity and performance for manufacturing and business-critical systems. Administer and troubleshoot LAN/WAN infrastructure, including managed switches, routers, and wireless access points, across the MCN and manufacturing floor. Manage and support firewalls and network segmentation between CORP, MCN, and DMZ zones, including rule review, change implementation, and connectivity troubleshooting. Configure and maintain Layer 2/Layer 3 networking, including VLANs, trunking, inter-VLAN routing, spanning tree, link aggregation, and dynamic routing protocols (e.g., OSPF). Perform packet-level and flow analysis (e.g., Wireshark, NetFlow/sFlow) to diagnose latency, packet loss, and intermittent connectivity faults. Engineering & Continuous Improvement Implement infrastructure changes in compliance with change management, cybersecurity, and GxP requirements. Maintain and improve server, network, virtualization, and platform environments. Identify opportunities to enhance reliability, resilience, maintainability, and operational efficiency. Support technology refreshes, upgrades, and lifecycle management activities. Design and implement network changes, such as VLAN and IP addressing schemes, firewall rule changes, and switch and firmware upgrades, using documented change and validation processes. Maintain network configuration baselines, backups, and version control for network devices. Support network resilience and redundancy, including high-availability pairs, redundant uplinks, and failover testing. Support secure remote and vendor access (VPN, jump hosts, Citrix, MFA) into controlled manufacturing environments. Monitoring & Compliance Monitor infrastructure health, availability, capacity, security, and performance. Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and support records. Contribute to audit readiness through adherence to validation, compliance, and documentation requirements. Support controlled manufacturing environments by ensuring systems remain secure and compliant. Configure and tune network monitoring (e.g., SNMP, syslog, NetFlow, and tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, or Zabbix), including alerting thresholds and capacity trending. Perform regular vulnerability, patch, and firmware management for network devices in line with cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST). Maintain current network diagrams, IP address management (IPAM) records, and asset inventories. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Manufacturing, Automation, Quality, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and vendor teams. Provide technical input on infrastructure design, operational support, and risk mitigation strategies. Participate in incident reviews, project delivery activities, and technical planning initiatives. Operational Support Participate in an on-call support as required to support a 24/7 manufacturing environment. Provide off-hours support during critical incidents, maintenance activities, and infrastructure upgrades when necessary. Act as Tier 3 escalation for network faults and lead major incident troubleshooting through to root cause analysis and post-incident review. Who You Are You are an experienced infrastructure professional with a strong background in supporting enterprise network and systems environments. You have hands-on experience working with technologies such as Windows and Linux servers, virtualization platforms, Active Directory, networking services, and infrastructure monitoring tools. You have in-depth, hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise switching, routing, and firewall platforms, and you are comfortable using protocol analysis and diagnostic tools to isolate faults at every layer of the OSI model. You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and are comfortable acting as a key escalation point for critical incidents. You understand the importance of system reliability, cybersecurity, compliance, and change management, particularly within manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated environments. You are a proactive and collaborative team player who can build effective relationships across Manufacturing, Automation, Quality, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and vendor teams. Your strong analytical and communication skills enable you to translate technical issues into business impact and drive practical solutions.anslate technical issues into business impact and drive practical solutions. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum of 5 years' experience supporting enterprise network and systems infrastructure. Strong working knowledge of Windows Server, Linux, VMware or other virtualization platforms, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and core networking concepts. Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP, the OSI model, subnetting, VLANs, routing and switching, NAT, and network services (DNS, DHCP, NTP). Hands-on experience configuring and supporting enterprise network equipment (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or equivalent). Experience with firewall administration, access control lists, and network segmentation. Experience with network monitoring and diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, SNMP-based monitoring, ping/traceroute/port testing). Experience with remote access technologies (VPN, Citrix, MFA). Hands-on experience troubleshooting complex issues across servers, networking, storage, identity services, security tools, and infrastructure platforms. Experience collaborating across infrastructure domains, including servers, virtualization, storage, backup, networking, cybersecurity, and operations teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Preferred Qualifications Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience supporting infrastructure within pharmaceutical, biotech, manufacturing, GxP-regulated, or other highly regulated environments. Experience with OT/ICS networks and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus/TCP, EtherNet/IP, OPC UA/DA, PROFINET), including the Purdue model and IEC 62443 concepts. Experience with network automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, Ansible) for configuration management and reporting, and with cybersecurity best practices. Industry certifications such as CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, CompTIA Network+/Security+, or equivalent. Experience with network access control (e.g., 802.1X, NAC), wireless design and site surveys, and structured cabling and fibre standards. Experience supporting historian, SCADA, MES, or DCS connectivity (e.g., OSI PI). Familiarity with software-defined networking or network visibility tools for OT environments. Job Level: Professional Why Biogen? We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives. At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Biogen is an E-Verify Employer in the United States.

review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: SSS is looking for a Senior Network & Systems Administrator to own our network, cloud and Microsoft 365 infrastructure. You'll be the go-to technical expert for keeping it reliable, scalable and high-performing, and for taking it forward. The role reports to the IT Manager and works closely with the Senior Cybersecurity Engineer. It is offshore-based, serving Samir Group (KSA), and works full-time on-site from our Heliopolis office. Key Responsibilities Own the design, implementation and optimization of the enterprise network: LAN/WAN, VLANs, routing (OSPF, BGP, static), Layer 2/3 switching and multi-site connectivity (site-to-site VPN, SD-WAN). Plan and lead infrastructure projects end to end, such as network redesigns, cloud migrations, upgrades and new site rollouts. Architect and administer Microsoft Azure and AWS environments: VMs, virtual networks (VNets, NSGs, route tables), Private Endpoints and Private DNS zones, storage, backup and disaster recovery, and cost optimization. Own Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange (Online and On-Premises) and Microsoft 365 administration, including hybrid identity through Entra Connect (sync, writeback, Hybrid Join) and hybrid Exchange. Harden and govern the Microsoft 365 tenant: MFA, Conditional Access, least-privilege admin roles and PIM, break-glass accounts, Secure Score and SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Lead device and application management through Microsoft Intune: Autopilot, enrollment, app packaging, configuration and compliance policies, and PowerShell scripts and remediations. Operate and maintain firewalls and VPNs in line with the security policies set by the Cybersecurity function. Manage public DNS, Cloudflare (DNS, proxy, WAF) and the SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle, keeping DNS records clean to prevent risks such as subdomain takeover. Support incident response with the Cybersecurity function: contain compromised accounts and devices (disable/reset accounts, revoke sessions, isolate devices with Microsoft Defender) and lead root cause analysis. Support pre-go-live security checks of published web applications (vulnerability assessment against OWASP Top 10) together with the Cybersecurity function. Design and support IP telephony, SIP and QoS. Set up capacity planning, monitoring and alerting so issues are caught before they affect users. Act as the final escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents, troubleshooting methodically across DNS, network, firewall/ports and change history. Apply change management on every change: SOPs, action plans, testing and rollback plans. Define technical standards and keep architecture documentation and network diagrams up to date. Mentor IT support staff and share technical knowledge across the team. Recommend technology improvements and support the IT Manager with roadmap and budget planning. Requirements Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field. 5+ years of experience in network and systems administration. Deep hands-on expertise in routing (OSPF, BGP), switching, VLANs and LAN/WAN design. Strong experience with Azure (VMs, VNets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Entra ID and Entra Connect); solid AWS experience. Proven experience administering Exchange (hybrid), Microsoft 365 and Intune (Autopilot, compliance policies) in enterprise environments, including Conditional Access and PIM. Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco or similar), public DNS, Cloudflare/WAF and SSL/TLS certificates.
